rounds.notes:
# ROUND 🔹1🔹
# POWERS💪
[Smashing!](item_a7021e28-cb8a-4f39-aeb1-380525b3fea9)
- this power even after it's nerfs is still really good at giving you movement speed and lifesteal which will keep you alive a lot of the time
# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- This round you can basically pick up anything you want but my recommendations are
- [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) this item will give you a nice little constant speed boost
- [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) a nice little damage boost
- [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) this items' lifesteal will also stack with [Smashing!](item_a7021e28-cb8a-4f39-aeb1-380525b3fea9) 

## OPTIONAL🗒️
- [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250) you can take this over [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) if you want but I personally like the constant consistent smaller speed boost over the short bigger speed boost
-  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) you can take this over  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) if you prefer attack speed over weapon damage but I genuinely don't think it makes a difference which you one you go lol

# ROUND GOAL🏁
Your goal for this round is basically just to play vanilla Reinhardt, Take space and be aggressive but don't go feeding in and gain as much money as you can

# ROUND 🔹2🔹

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7)![Image](https://i.imgur.com/BWWGzdl.gif "small")
- [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250) now that we have  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) you can swap out  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) if you want because the speed boost we have now is pretty consistent 
## SELL🗑️
- If you didn't get enough money from round 1 sell some of the green items to get  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7)
## OPTIONAL🗒️
- [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28) if you somehow are swimming in cash after round 1 and after you buy  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) and are against a lucio booping you off cooldown go ahead and pick this up
- [Crusader’s Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619) same thing but for antis if you have the excess cash and are against a [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1) or [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) and you don't have a [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) or [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) with [Voidhoppers](item_d4ce0c76-2500-40d6-b066-dca303be097f) you can pick this up
# ROUND GOAL🏁
 [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) lets us be a bit more aggressive and get away with it especially against heroes like [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) or [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0) but you will still explode if you're not careful so still play it like round 1 aka gain as much money as you can die as little as you can and be a menace

round_upgrades.notes: Only pick this up if you can afford it and there is an enemy Lucio booping you off cooldown
Only pick this up if you can afford it and are against antis and don't have a kiri or moira to cleanse you

rounds.notes:
# ROUND 🔹3🔹
# POWERS💪
**This is where you can choose your own path based on how rounds 1 and 2 went**

[Feeling the Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399) 
- this is my go to choice for round 3 if I'm not getting absolutely destroyed in the first 2 rounds the burn you apply will proc [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) it's not a lot of healing but it definitely helps

OR

[To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f) 
- if I feel like I'm exploding too much or not getting enough healing from my supports I'll take this instead which will give you the added benefit of charging shatter a lot faster with your self-healing
# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) I go with this no matter which path you decide on picking this up will help you survive a lot more synergizing with [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) quite well also it will allow your [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) if you have one to build her Kitsune Rush faster as well if she has  [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) or plans to get it in a later round
- [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) if you can afford to pick this up definitely go for it you can also do [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66) instead if you're against a tank that has shields or armor like [Sigma](hero_646d9571-c40a-4403-b6c1-fb67adb6112d) or [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85)
## SELL🗑️
- If you need too you can sell a couple of the green items like [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) or [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) to afford the blue items
## OPTIONAL🗒️
- [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28) this is far more likely when you'd want to pick up this item or [Crusader’s Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619) depending on what you're going against once again only pick these up if you're having trouble with the boops/anti-heals otherwise there's no real need
# ROUND GOAL🏁
Now that you have [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) and [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) you can be more aggressive and take more risks the build isn't at turn your brain off and swing levels yet though so just play with maybe 2 brain cells instead of 1 and you'll have very few if any deaths and you'll be gettin' plenty of money as well

# ROUND 🔹4🔹

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) you can now start building into some big damage as well as survivability 
## SELL🗑️
- [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) 
## OPTIONAL🗒️
- [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) if you have a ton of extra cash you can pick up this item early to get a nice boost to a bunch of stats 

OR
- [Codebreaker](item_caa96c7e-655f-4d03-9bd9-0f41937fec27) if the enemy tank has a bunch of armor like [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) or [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) you can pick this up instead of [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) and deal more damage to them
# ROUND GOAL🏁
you're starting to become a pretty large threat this round so just keep doing what you're doing, taking space, absorbing damage, not feeding and you're gonna be gucci

# ROUND 🔹5🔹
# POWERS💪
- You're gonna pick up the power you didn't chose on round 3
# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) the handful of stats this item grants is great for damage and survivability 
## SELL🗑️
- [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) we don't need this now that we have [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) 
## OPTIONAL🗒️
- [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f) once again if you have the extra cash you can sell your last green item and get this this will only give you the stats at 100% ultimate charge so if you do pick this up be more greedy using your ult charge but if you see a good time to shatter definitely go for it 
- [Dampener Grip](item_451f8c81-1821-48a4-a980-ae1cebd61a85) this is really useful if you're running the version of this build that goes against anti-heals and such letting you charge more often therefore cleansing yourself more often so if that is the case pick this up if you have the extra money instead of [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f) 
# ROUND GOAL🏁
Current Objective: Survive

# ROUND 🔹6🔹

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f) we're picking up this item now as stated in the last round's notes this will only give you the bonus stats at full ultimate charge so be more stingy about when you ult but don't be afraid too
## SELL🗑️
- [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250) as stated before the stats we gained from this item are now covered by [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f)
## OPTIONAL🗒️
- If you want to skip ahead yet again you can sell [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and buy [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) which will make you even tankier at the cost of a bit of damage

# ROUND 🔹7🔹
# POWERS💪
My choices for the final round power are 
- [Shield Stampede](item_0c4ef690-6472-48fe-9257-864c4381f584) this will make charging in a lot safer allowing you to close the distance to the enemy and get into your hammer range

OR
- [Vanguard](item_228cf103-0be8-4f1c-8780-f3a8d8676abf) this is a pretty good choice as well especially because you also gain the overhealth from the charge so if you're doing the anti anti-heal version of the build as you'd be cleansed and gain overhealth at the same time
# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) 
## SELL🗑️
- [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a)
